Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring inspections of remodels to single-family residences.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to improving enforcement of the state buildingcode; amending RCW 19.27.050; creating a new section; and providing aneffective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that among thelaudable purposes and objectives for adopting a state building code isthe promotion of the health, safety, and welfare of homeowners whoremodel or add to their homes. The legislature further finds that such purposes are not met unlessthe state building code is effectively enforced through a comprehensiveinspection program, which emphasizes inspections of remodels andadditions to owneroccupied, singlefamily homes.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 19.27.050 and 1985 c 360 s 9 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The state building code required by this chapter shall beenforced by the counties and cities. Any county or city not having abuilding department shall contract with another county, city, or p. 1 SSB 6156inspection agency approved by the county or city for enforcement of thestate building code within its jurisdictional boundaries. (2) A county or city violates this section when the jurisdictionfails to provide: (a) An owner of record, who is remodeling or addingto an owneroccupied, singlefamily residence, a copy of the inspectionschedule from the local permit issuing authority by regular mail; and(b) a copy of the inspection schedule from the local permit issuingauthority to the owner of record at the site of the first inspectionrequired by the local permit issuing authority. The requirements ofthis subsection only apply to remodels or additions to owneroccupied,singlefamily residences.
